body.name: Gaussian local parameter manifold
body.construction: \(\Theta_n^{\mathrm G}=\{\theta\in\Theta_n:\mathsf Q_{\varepsilon}\text{ is the law of independent }N(0,\Sigma)\text{ vectors over all pre dates and induces independent }N(0,\Sigma_{DD})\text{ donor vectors over all observed post dates}\}\subseteq\Theta_n\), with the rank and spectral constraints inherited from \(\Theta_n\).  The displayed subset relation is part of the construction.
